title: HerdProof recorded project evidence

detector.scope: Exploratory previously inspected test benchmark with provisional labels; not fresh blind validation

overlap.scope: Controlled stationary-cow crop suites with supplied annotation boxes and known identities. Separate from detector accuracy and whole-herd validation.

limitations: Estimated distinct sightings; detection and association errors remain possible.
Sparse photographs do not verify complete property coverage.
Different flights and capture dates are reported separately, never summed as one herd.

attribution.creators: Louise Helary and Adrien Lebreton / Institut de l’Elevage

note: Recorded technical results, separate from the selected live survey. No whole-herd inventory, ownership, lending outcome or time saving is established.
